draft.title: Balanced and unbalanced forces
card: Several forces can act on an object at once. What matters is the total effect of all of them together.
Force arrows show each force acting on an object. The length of an arrow shows the size of the force, and its direction shows which way the force acts.
forces that are equal in size and opposite in direction, so they cancel out. An object at rest stays still, and a moving object keeps moving at the same speed in the same direction.
forces that do not cancel out. The object starts moving, stops, speeds up, slows down or changes direction.
draft.remember: Read the arrows. Equal arrows in opposite directions are balanced and the motion stays the same. Unequal arrows are unbalanced and change the motion.

a.q: A force diagram of a box on a floor shows an arrow of 20 N to the right and an arrow of 35 N to the left. What do the arrows show?
opts: Unbalanced forces, so the box changes its motion
Balanced forces, so the box changes its motion
Balanced forces, so the box keeps its motion the same
Unbalanced forces, so the box keeps its motion the same
a.why: The arrows point in opposite directions but are different lengths, so they do not cancel. Unbalanced forces change the motion. Here the bigger force is to the left, so the box is pushed that way.
a.clue: Are the two arrows the same length?

b.q: Two teams pull on opposite ends of a rope with equal force, and the rope does not move. Team A then pulls harder while Team B stays the same. What happens to the rope?
opts: It moves towards Team A because the forces are unbalanced
It stays still because the forces are still balanced
It moves towards Team B because the forces are unbalanced
It stays still because the forces are unbalanced
b.why: At first the equal, opposite pulls cancel, so the rope stays still. When Team A pulls harder the forces no longer cancel, so the rope starts to move in the direction of the bigger force, towards Team A. Team B's pull is smaller, so the rope does not go that way.
b.clue: Which team now has the bigger pull?

a.best: Unbalanced forces, so the box changes its motion

b.best: It moves towards Team A because the forces are unbalanced
